title: Entity overview data
responsibility: Assembles an entity’s contract and measurements, retaining focused observations for the same commit or identical complete source tree with original provenance. Selected helper Uses resolve only callees attributed to its exact named caller at that revision.

inputs.name: entityShown.host
inputs.description: Shown revision and optional parent context.

inputs.name: entityShown.entity
inputs.description: Entity to describe, including category, unit and removal state.

inputs.name: entityChanged.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier used to select its explanations.

inputs.name: helperEntity.owner
inputs.description: Owning module entity at the selected revision.

inputs.name: helperEntity.helperName
inputs.description: Optional selected callable name; no matching callable returns undefined.

inputs.name: helperRelations.host
inputs.description: Selected revision registry and named helper route.

inputs.name: helperRelations.entity
inputs.description: Selected callable and its real owning unit identity.

inputs.name: helperRelations.relations
inputs.description: Existing module relationships whose Used In side remains available.

outputs.name: entityShown
outputs.description: Readable contract, measurements and the selected verdict record. Removed entities use parent declarations for applicable states. Source and full-record figures can be supplemented by focused observations of the same commit or identical complete source tree, retaining their tested revision without granting a full verification verdict.

outputs.name: entityChanged
outputs.description: Bounded and full explanations recorded by the head for that unit.

outputs.name: helperEntity
outputs.description: One callable’s actual parameters, return, errors and source. Keeps owning unit id for module evidence; excludes sibling APIs and unscoped multi-callable documentation.

outputs.name: helperRelations.relations
outputs.description: Selected helper callees from per-callable consumer facts; owner-module dependencies never leak into Uses. Unselected module relationships remain unchanged.
